1: The number $\log_{\sqrt7}7$ is equal to: A. 2 B. 7 C. $\sqrt7$ D. $\frac12$
3: If 75% of a number $a$ equals 177 and 59% of a number $b$ equals 177, then: A. $b-a=26$ B. $b-a=64$ C. $a-b=26$ D. $a-b=64$
4: The equation $x(5x+1)=5x+1$ has exactly: A. one solution: $x=1$. B. two solutions: $x=1$ and $x=-1$. C. two solutions: $x=-\frac15$ and $x=1$. D. two solutions: $x=\frac15$ and $x=-1$.
5: The pair of numbers $x=3$ and $y=1$ is a solution of the system of equations $\begin{cases}-x+12y=a^2\\2x+ay=9\end{cases}$ for: A. $a=\frac73$ B. $a=-3$ C. $a=3$ D. $a=-\frac73$
6: The equation $\frac{(x-2)(x+4)}{(x-4)^2}=0$ has exactly: A. one solution: $x=2$. B. one solution: $x=-2$. C. two solutions: $x=2, x=-4$. D. two solutions: $x=-2, x=4$.
7: The zeros of the quadratic function $f$ given by $f(x)=9-(3-x)^2$ are the numbers: A. 0 and 3 B. -6 and 6 C. 0 and -6 D. 0 and 6
9: A number greater than 5 is: A. $\left(\frac{1}{25}\right)^{-\frac12}$ B. $\left(\frac{1}{25}\right)^{-\frac15}$ C. $125^{\frac23}$ D. $125^{\frac13}$
10: Point $A=(a,3)$ lies on the line given by the equation $y=\frac34x+6$. It follows that: A. $a=-4$ B. $a=4$ C. $a=\frac{33}{4}$ D. $a=\frac{39}{4}$
11: In the arithmetic sequence $(a_n)$, defined for $n\ge1$, two terms are given: $a_1=-11$ and $a_9=5$. The sum of the first nine terms of this sequence equals: A. -24 B. -27 C. -16 D. -18
12: All terms of the geometric sequence $(a_n)$, defined for $n\ge1$, are positive numbers. The second term of this sequence equals 162, and the fifth term equals 48. This means that the ratio of this sequence equals: A. $\frac23$ B. $\frac34$ C. $\frac13$ D. $\frac12$
13: The cosine of an acute angle $\alpha$ equals $\frac{12}{13}$. Then: A. $\sin\alpha=\frac{13}{12}$ B. $\sin\alpha=\frac{1}{13}$ C. $\sin\alpha=\frac{5}{13}$ D. $\sin\alpha=\frac{25}{169}$
14: Given is an isosceles triangle $ABC$ in which $|AC|=|BC|$. On the base $AB$ of this triangle lies a point $D$ such that $|AD|=|CD|$, $|BC|=|BD|$, and $\angle BCD=72°$ (see figure). It follows that angle $ACD$ has measure: A. $38°$ B. $36°$ C. $42°$ D. $40°$ [Figure: triangle ABC with point D on side AB; angle BCD marked 72° at vertex C between CB and CD]
15: A circle with center at point $S=(a,5)$ is tangent to the $Oy$ axis and to the line with equation $y=2$. The radius of this circle equals: A. 3 B. 5 C. 2 D. 4
16: The base of the regular quadrilateral pyramid $ABCDS$ is the square $ABCD$ (see figure). All lateral faces of this pyramid are equilateral triangles. The measure of angle $SAC$ equals: A. $60°$ B. $45°$ C. $90°$ D. $75°$ [Figure: pyramid ABCDS, square base ABCD, apex S]
17: The lines with equations $y=(4m+1)x-19$ and $y=(5m-4)x+20$ are parallel when: A. $m=5$ B. $m=-\frac14$ C. $m=\frac54$ D. $m=-5$
18: In the coordinate system, point $S=(40,40)$ is the midpoint of segment $KL$, one of whose endpoints is point $K=(0,8)$. Therefore: A. $L=(20,24)$ B. $L=(-80,-72)$ C. $L=(-40,-24)$ D. $L=(80,72)$
19: Point $P=(-6,-8)$ was first transformed by reflection about the $Ox$ axis, and then by reflection about the $Oy$ axis. As a result of these transformations, point $Q$ was obtained. Therefore: A. $Q=(6,8)$ B. $Q=(-6,-8)$ C. $Q=(8,6)$ D. $Q=(-8,-6)$
22: The total surface area of a certain cone is 3 times greater than the surface area of a certain sphere. The radius of this sphere equals 2 and is the same as the radius of the base of this cone. The slant height of this cone has length equal to: A. 12 B. 11 C. 24 D. 22
23: The arithmetic mean of the ten natural numbers 3, 10, 5, x, x, x, x, 12, 19, 7 equals 12. The median of these numbers equals: A. 14 B. 12 C. 16 D. x
24: The number of all four-digit even natural numbers in which only the digits 1, 2, 3 appear is: A. 54 B. 81 C. 8 D. 27
25: In a group of 60 people (women and men) there are 35 women. One person is drawn from this group. The probability of drawing each person is the same. The probability of the event that a man is drawn equals: A. $\frac{1}{60}$ B. $\frac{1}{25}$ C. $\frac{7}{12}$ D. $\frac{5}{12}$
30: From the set of all two-digit natural numbers, one number is drawn at random. Compute the probability of event $A$, that the drawn number has, in its decimal representation, a tens digit belonging to the set $\{1,3,5,7,9\}$ and, at the same time, a units digit belonging to the set $\{0,2,4,6,8\}$.
32: In the arithmetic sequence $(a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_{39}, a_{40})$, the sum of the terms of this sequence with even indices equals 1340, and the sum of the terms with odd indices equals 1400. Find the last term of this arithmetic sequence.
33: The center of a circle lies at a distance of 10 cm from a chord of this circle. The length of this chord is 22 cm greater than the radius of this circle. Compute the radius of this circle.
34: The length of the lateral edge of the regular quadrilateral pyramid $ABCDS$ equals 12 (see figure). The lateral edge forms with the height of this pyramid an angle $\alpha$ such that $\tan\alpha=\frac{2}{\sqrt5}$. Compute the volume of this pyramid.
